children: RNS Number : 3260T  CT Global Managed Portfolio - CMPI  03 September 2026
From:              CT Global Managed Portfolio Trust PLC
First Interim Dividend for the Financial Year to 31 May 2027
CT Global Managed Portfolio Trust PLC (the "Company") announces a first interim dividend in respect of the financial year to 31 May 2027 of 2.00 pence per Income share.
This dividend is payable on 9 October 2026 to shareholders on the register on 11 September 2026, with an ex-dividend date of 10 September 2026.
The current pattern for the Company is to pay four quarterly interim dividends per financial year.

As previously announced, in the absence of unforeseen circumstances, it is the Board's intention to pay four quarterly interim dividends, each of at least 2.00 pence per Income share, so that the aggregate dividends for the financial year to 31 May 2027 will be at least 8.00 pence per Income share (2026: 7.85 pence per Income share).
